## 2. Product Line & Specifications

### 2.1 BROSKI Bro Bites (Non-Veg)
- **Net Weight:** 400 grams
- **SKU:** BR-NV-400G
- **MRP:** ₹149 (Inclusive of all taxes)
- **Biscuit Shape:** Classic bone shape
- **Packaging:** Stand-up barrier pouch with transparent product viewing window and resealable zip.
- **Guidance:** A treat, not a meal. Fresh drinking water should always be available.

### 2.2 BROSKI Bro Mix
- **Net Weight:** 400 grams
- **SKU:** BR-MX-400G
- **MRP:** ₹179 (Inclusive of all taxes)
- **Biscuit Shape:** Bone shape
- **Packaging:** Stand-up barrier pouch with transparent product viewing window and resealable zip.

### 2.3 BROSKI Peanut Butter Dog Biscuits
- **Net Weight:** 400 grams
- **SKU:** BR-PB-400G
- **MRP:** ₹179 (Inclusive of all taxes)
- **Biscuit Shape:** Bone shape
- **Packaging:** Stand-up barrier pouch with transparent product viewing window and resealable zip.

### 2.4 BROSKI Bro Combo
- **Net Weight:** 800 grams (1 Bro Bites + 1 Bro Mix)
- **SKU:** BR-CB-800G
- **MRP:** ₹299 (Save ₹29)

### 2.5 Pilot Sampler Pouches (50g)
- **Net Weight:** 50 grams
- **Purpose:** Distributed during West Delhi neighborhood sampling drives to allow dogs to taste-test before owners purchase full 400g pouches.
- **Interactive QR Code:** Directs to https://broskipetfood.com/r/ for feedback submission and repeat-order discount codes.

---

## 3. Distribution, Logistics & Wholesale
- **Target Territory (Pilot Phase):** West Delhi clusters: Nangloi, Paschim Vihar, Janakpuri, Rajouri Garden, Punjabi Bagh, Dwarka.
- **Retailer Terms:** Wholesale case packs (12 pouches per counter box, 11+1 free introductory offer) with healthy retailer margins and free display material.
- **Direct-to-Consumer:** Orders placed via WhatsApp or website are packed fresh in Nangloi and dispatched via local courier partners across Delhi NCR within 24–48 hours.
